title: A circle or shape with a gradient fill
text: shape.create {kind: ellipse|rect|roundedRect|polygon|star|line|path, rect: [x, y, w, h], fill: {gradient: {stops: [[0, '#hex'], [1, '#hex']], style: 'radial'|'linear'|'angle'|'reflected'|'diamond', angle, scale}}, stroke?: {width, color}}. A gradient fill LAYER over the whole canvas is layer.newFillLayer.gradient instead.

title: Writing the document to a file
text: craftmcp.py export photocraft path=<absolute file> (the gateway gives PhotoCraft a write folder; a PNG keeps transparency), or doc_export with a relative path. doc_render_preview returns an image of the flattened canvas without writing a file.

title: Recipe: soft highlight and film grain clipped to a shape
text: Highlight: shape.create an ellipse with an RGBA fill, layer.rasterize.shape, filter.blur.gaussianBlur, layer.createClippingMask (clips to the layer below). Grain: layer.new.layer, select.all, edit.fill #808080, filter.noise.addNoise (gaussian, monochromatic), layer.layerStyle.blendingOptions {blend: overlay, opacity}, layer.createClippingMask. Depth: layer.layerStyle.innerShadow.

title: Closing documents
text: doc_close does not work through the GUI bridge. file.close {document: index} closes one (it does not ask about unsaved changes), and craftmcp.py cleanup photocraft lists and closes throwaway documents safely (dry run by default).
